item.title: 25 years after 9/11, the WTC's final office tower is rising; it's a 55-story, 1,226-foot building
item.description: Construction has officially begun on the last commercial office tower at the World Trade Center site. This impressive 55-story structure will be the new global headquarters for American Express. Spanning nearly two million square feet, it’s projected to be fully operational by 2031, contributing billions to the economy and creating thousands of new jobs. This marks a pivotal milestone in the site's redevelopment after 25 years. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Scientists fitted GPS collars to 17 lions and 14 hyenas expecting hyenas to follow lions
item.description: A groundbreaking study suggests that it's the male lions that approach spotted hyenas, contrary to the belief that hyenas seek out lion remains for food. In fact, spotted hyenas are known to back away from lions, prioritizing their safety. This finding highlights the importance of spatial avoidance in hyena behavior, emphasizing their adaptive strategies to circumvent confrontations with such powerful hunters. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Montana seals 20 hazards at five abandoned uranium sites that once supplied US defence program
item.description: Several abandoned uranium mine sites in Montana’s Pryor Mountains have been closed after assessments found physical hazards, radiation and chemical contamination risks.
